Least-squares fit of the four captions that agree: C.L OF CENTRAL CABIN (CH:580.432M) x 2627.0, SRJ CH:1153.620M x 3897.1, SRJ CH:1200.735M x 4028.7, FM CH:1209.209M x 4056.0 (rms 5.6 m; residuals +1.0, -9.1, +2.3, +5.9 m). CH:529.0M (with L 702, x 1218 on the bulb line near DUMPER CABIN CONTROLS) does not fit (-43 m by the fit) and was left out. Read individual chainages from chainageMarks.
